name: nvoos-site-bridge
description: Operate a WordPress site running NV oOS (Open Operator System) through its native MCP bridge: content research and publishing, WooCommerce operations, media workflows, and site administration tools packaged as ChatGPT and Codex skills.

interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT and Codex access to NV oOS-powered WordPress sites over MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the MCP bridge of a WordPress site running NV oOS (base + Pro). Bundles skills for site operations, content research and publishing, and WooCommerce store management, with the site's own assistant-scoped credentials enforcing least-privilege access.
defaultPrompt: Use the NV oOS site bridge to list the most recent posts on the connected WordPress site.
